This role is responsible for supporting end-to-end contract and procurement activities on a major capital development project. With a focus on construction works and services, capital procurement, and pre- and post-award contract management, you will play a key role in delivering commercially robust outcomes aligned to project objectives and compliance requirements.

  • Core Competencies: High attention to detail, ability to produce clear and commercially sound documentation, and a proactive, accountable, and outcome-driven approach.
